content: 231 of 535 Document ID 19: AUTOSAR_SWS_DiagnosticEventManager Specification of Diagnostic Event Manager AUTOSAR CP R20-11 Service Name Dem_ResetEventStatus Syntax Std_ReturnType Dem_ResetEventStatus ( Dem_EventIdType EventId ) Service ID [hex] 0x05 Sync/Async Asynchronous Reentrancy Reentrant for different EventIds. Non reentrant for the same EventId. Parameters (in) EventId Identification of an event by assigned EventId. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK: Request to reset the event status was successful accepted. E_NOT_OK: Request to reset the event status failed or is not allowed, because the event is already tested in this operation cycle. Description Resets the event failed status. This API can only be used through the RTE and therefore no declaration is exported via Dem.h. Available via Dem.h
